# HexPiece 2.6.5

The sword still flickering with Haki on in first person. Nothing here has been tested in game yet; the build's checks pass.

- **The Haki coat can no longer knock out the sword view.** If anything in the coat or its timing fails, the blade is just drawn
  uncoated for that frame, instead of the whole first-person sword dropping out.
- **No more strobing.** If the sword view keeps failing, it now waits 10 seconds before trying again, instead of flashing every
  second.
- **If it still flickers or lags, please send your latest.log** (in the game folder's logs) so the real error can be seen.
